ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio with approximately 85-90% of the surface area comprised of low-intensity (dark) pixels and 10-15% of high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated in localized markings and tip regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity uniform field across both lobes; localized high-intensity circular clusters (barnacles) at distal tips; scattered mid-intensity linear streaks and mottled grey regions across the central and lateral surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth equal to roughly 6% of the total horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from micro-serrations to deep irregular indentations, most notably a large concave excavation on the mid-lateral trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer leading edges exhibit a continuous concave curve toward the tips; trailing edges follow a general convex arc modulated by significant localized edge irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast circular pixel clusters (3-7 pixels in diameter) localized at the extreme distal points of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-aligned dark linear pixel disruptions; includes a series of diagonal parallel lines on the left lobe and more pronounced, thicker dark linear scars on the outer third of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular notch or tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive dark linear scarification on the dorsal/distal portion of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct dark geometric scar resembling a right-angle or 'L' shape located on the upper distal surface of the right lobe.
